meta.solver: rk4_batch via model.run_batch (event-synced; LSODA for the default-theta 'nominal')

deviations: constant-load cells use h = 10 s instead of the §9 default 2 s (no input switches); step_check compares h = 10 s with h = 2 s on the first 256 Sobol' points of five cells
standby S1/S2a/S2b at 0 and -10 C use N = 512 (first 512 Sobol' points, a balanced subset), not 2048
S15 starts (50 / 20 %) only for the §5.2 S15 set S4, S5a, S7, S12 (S13 is stochastic); S11 only at 25 C
S9 is run at the T3 temperatures 25 / 0 / -10 C (T0 = 20 C), plus -10 and -20 C at SOH 0.8
variance split inner moments are L0 (F6-F7); the L2 check rescales by the pooled L2/L0 ratio measured on the same paths

usage-model factors (§4.6) and the second pick-freeze sample B are pseudo-random (seeds 2027-2029), paired by index with the Sobol' θ sample: two index-paired scrambled Sobol' sequences are not independent

S13/S14 hardware-vs-usage-model split (an addition to §9) uses a pick-freeze group decomposition (Jansen totals, first order by the two-group identity) on the F6-F7 inner means; the §9 two-way split (usage path vs hardware) is reported as usage_frac/param_frac, and a direct full-L2 split is estimated from the 50 x 200 check
